decisions.question: Which open-source architecture should Ziras adopt for the discovery engine core?
options: Scrapy static acquisition with Scrapy+Playwright browser fallback and PostgreSQL/PostGIS/pgvector/PostgresHuey
Build a custom crawler/discovery infrastructure stack
decisions.decision: Adopt ADR-001: Scrapy 2.18.0 with scrapy-playwright 0.0.48 fallback; deterministic extraction with Extruct/Trafilatura/price-parser/Dateparser; PostgreSQL 16 with PostGIS and pgvector; PostgresHuey 3.3.4; Photon behind a Geocoder port; deterministic MVP ranking with implicit deferred until sufficient behavioral data.
decisions.rationale: The selected stack passed the broad Malta-oriented OSS qualification while minimizing overlapping frameworks and infrastructure. It preserves source-policy controls and narrow replacement boundaries instead of building generic crawler, GIS, vector, queue or recommendation infrastructure from scratch.
